title: Provision storage for a service (Azure Blob)
description: The reports service is configured to write to an Azure Blob container that does not exist yet. Create it, prove you can write and read a blob, then let the service verify its own round trip.

objectives.label: Create the container the reports service is configured for
Upload a text blob and download the same content
Verify the service's own write and read through its storage check

hints: Read the api logs or inspect it: which container does the service write to, and what error does it report?
Create exactly that container in the Cloud panel. Container names use lowercase letters, numbers, and single hyphens.
Upload a small text blob, download it, then run the service storage check. Listing blobs does not prove the service can reach them.
solution: Cloud panel: upload notes.txt with any text to lab-reports, then read notes.txt
